description:
What happens when a congressional hearing becomes more than a policy debate?

In a series of tense exchanges on Capitol Hill, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent found himself at the centre of heated arguments over inflation, taxation, government policy, and the economic impact of international conflicts. But one seemingly simple history question unexpectedly became one of the most talked-about moments of the hearings.

In this episode, we break down the most dramatic exchanges, examine the economic arguments behind the political rhetoric, and explore why these hearings reveal so much about how modern Washington operates.

Beyond the viral moments and sharp one-liners, this story offers a deeper look at the intersection of economics, politics, and public perception in today's America.
